name: Tile-based Volume Ray Marching
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores 3D volume data in a 1D texture array organized into tiles, using ray marching to sample the volume and composite the result using front-to-back accumulation.
summary: Tile-based Volume Ray Marching is a GPU-accelerated technique that stores 3D data in 2D tiles to manage memory, distinguishing itself through explicit 1D-to-2D coordinate conversion and linear interpolation between tile boundaries.
